author: GovRonDeSantis
text:
Today, we welcomed lottery leaders from around the world to the Sunshine State for the North American Association of State and Provincial Lotteries conference in Orlando.

The @floridalottery was created to generate revenue for education. Nearly four decades on, generations of students have benefited. Today, Florida has the lowest in-state university tuition in the nation and our Bright Futures scholarship provides full or partial tuition awards. 75% of our in-state students graduate with zero debt!
